description:
Invoke function getMicrosoft365CopilotUsageUserDetail

TIP: Gets per-user Microsoft 365 Copilot usage detail over a period — for adoption tracking and license utilization analysis. period: 'D7' | 'D30' | 'D90' | 'D180'. Returns one row per user (UPN, display name, last activity date, last activity dates per Copilot-enabled app: Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote, Loop, M365 Chat). Useful for: identifying inactive license assignments (Copilot license costs ~$30 USD/user/month → ROI analysis), spotting power users vs dormant, planning training rollouts. Anonymized at the org level if 'Display concealed names in reports' is enabled in admin center.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

name: get-copilot-usage-user-detail
